prompt:
Create one opaque square 4 by 4 albedo texture atlas for four owned dark-fantasy nineteenth-century Argentine folklore character models. Exactly sixteen equal square cells, no gutters, labels, text, borders, scenery or whole bodies. All materials are finely painted diffuse surfaces under even frontal lighting, small-scale pores/fibers, understated realistic aged detail. This sheet will wrap actual closed 3D anatomy and clothes; it is not a sprite sheet.
Top row left to right, four distinct complete frontal FACE texture patches: (1) stern elderly human woman, warm olive-beige skin, deeply lined brow and cheeks, thoughtful brown eyes, moderately long nose, thin closed lips, no makeup; (2) weathered middle-aged olive-tan man, brown eyes, strong nose, dark eyebrows, salt-and-pepper short beard and moustache, closed mouth; (3) gaunt elderly female folklore hag, pale leathery tan skin, long hooked nose, sunken golden-green eyes, pronounced wrinkles, angular chin, no beard, closed mouth; (4) a different elderly female hag with slightly wider leathery face, amber eyes, bulbous crooked nose, furrowed brow and downturned closed lips. Each cell includes the entire forehead and full chin with a little room, ears not required, no hats or hair across faces, no neck/body. Four distinct facial identities, not copies.
Second row left to right: (5) worn near-black charcoal fine woven wool with very subtle tiny muted ochre worn embroidery, NOT coarse basket texture; (6) fine ivory linen, tiny fibers, gently aged warm shading; (7) fine ash-gray and silver flowing hair strands; (8) finely woven dark brown poncho cloth with four narrow parallel ivory stripes running vertically, small tight yarns.
Third row: (9) dark earth-brown worn ragged cloth with tiny sparse irregular wear and fine thread grain, still opaque; (10) light ochre-gray coarse linen apron cloth, finer texture rather than large ropes; (11) fine dry tan straw/hay hat weave with slender fibers and age marks; (12) dark worn brown leather with fine cracked grain.
Fourth row: (13) aged pale tan skin with fine wrinkles, veins and pores, subtle not extreme; (14) aged olive-tan male skin, subtle hair and pores; (15) dark old bronze with subtle patina; (16) muted gray-green dry leaves and fine herbal sprigs as a dense evenly lit material surface, no container, no background.
Faces should be recognizable hand-painted realism with complete chins. Cloth microtexture must be fine and subdued at game scale, without giant stitches. Earthy palette, neutral light, no glow, no cast shadows, no logos, no invented symbols or writing. Four faces occupy only the top row; remaining twelve cells are uninterrupted square materials. Preserve exact 4x4 layout and opaque pixels.
review: Four complete face cells and twelve fine cloth/hair/skin/straw/leather/herb/bronze material cells. Original opaque pixels preserved unchanged; explicit data-owned UV rectangles follow the actual cell boundaries.
